info.name: SDA — API reference
info.description: Every documented API operation, grouped by module. Select individual requests and supply valid current IDs/body fields; use the separate Complete integration workflow for ordered execution. Mutation/deletion requests operate on the records you supply. Credentials and token are environment variables, blank in checked-in examples.

List scoped property publication reviews

Requires properties / properties:read. Newest property first; status defaults pending. Queue excludes owner contacts, addresses and private uploads. Publication toggle alone does not establish public visibility.

Manual reference: fill IDs and timestamps in the environment first. Do not run this entire reference collection as a workflow. See OpenAPI/API.md for filters and alternatives.

Inspect current listing content and moderation history

Requires properties / properties:read. Transactional current revision and complete chronological review snapshots; no private owner contacts/address. Legacy retained publication has null actor and snapshot with legacy_approved action.

Manual reference: fill IDs and timestamps in the environment first. Do not run this entire reference collection as a workflow. See OpenAPI/API.md for filters and alternatives.

Approve or reject the inspected listing revision

Requires properties.moderate + properties and properties:moderate ability (sign in again for older staff sessions). expected_revision must equal current content revision. Pending revision only; exact same decision/reason on same revision replays with 200 and no duplicate history; any stale revision, opposing decision or changed reason returns 409. A public content/photo edit increments revision and hides listing pending fresh review. Approval still requires publication intent, available status and active agent for public catalogue/enquiries. Does not change deal/status or transfer money.

Manual reference: fill IDs and timestamps in the environment first. Do not run this entire reference collection as a workflow. See OpenAPI/API.md for filters and alternatives.

Resubmit rejected content for another review

Requires properties.edit + properties and properties:write; does not grant approval. Rejected expected_revision becomes a new pending revision with a resubmission note. Exact retry by same actor/reason returns current state for that new revision, even after it is decided. Other payload/actor, changed content or wrong status/revision returns 409. Reopening by editing public content is automatic.

Manual reference: fill IDs and timestamps in the environment first. Do not run this entire reference collection as a workflow. See OpenAPI/API.md for filters and alternatives.

Read scoped aggregate saved-property counts

Requires properties role permission and properties:read. Counts current memberships from active customer accounts. Own/group/global property visibility applies. Includes private/inactive/unreviewed inventory only within authorized staff scope. No customer names/emails/IDs, owner contacts or individual save timestamps. Descending saved count, then descending property ID; min_count default1, per_page default20/max100.

Dashboard overview

Requires property-reports + reports:read; agents also requires property-reports.agents. Each source independently requires ACL + token ability: properties/properties:read, properties.enquiries/enquiries:read, leads/leads:read, leads.view/leads:read (follow-ups), visits/visits:read. All-permission roles still obey token and record scopes. Dates select created_at for properties/enquiries/leads, due date for tasks, starts_at for visits. Current ownership/status, not historical snapshots. No default date bound. Optional timezone interprets inclusive from/to calendar dates; the next local calendar date is the exclusive bound, converted to application storage time.

Manual reference: fill IDs and timestamps in the environment first. Do not run this entire reference collection as a workflow. See OpenAPI/API.md for filters and alternatives.

Paginated agent lead and visit performance

Requires property-reports + reports:read; agents also requires property-reports.agents. Each source independently requires ACL + token ability: properties/properties:read, properties.enquiries/enquiries:read, leads/leads:read, leads.view/leads:read (follow-ups), visits/visits:read. All-permission roles still obey token and record scopes. Dates select created_at for properties/enquiries/leads, due date for tasks, starts_at for visits. Current ownership/status, not historical snapshots. No default date bound. Only agents with matching accessible leads or visits are returned; inactive agents with history included. At least one lead/visit source is required. Metrics from inaccessible sources are null. Separate grouped subqueries prevent duplicated counts; ordered by user ID. Optional timezone interprets inclusive from/to calendar dates; the next local calendar date is the exclusive bound, converted to application storage time.

Manual reference: fill IDs and timestamps in the environment first. Do not run this entire reference collection as a workflow. See OpenAPI/API.md for filters and alternatives.

Download filtered agent performance as a safe CSV attachment

Same property-reports + property-reports.agents permissions, reports:read ability, source ACL/abilities and own/group/global scope as JSON agent report. All filtered matching agents exported, ignoring page/per_page, ordered by user ID. Cap 5000; larger exports return JSON 422 export validation before CSV headers, never truncate. Only permitted lead/visit columns; metadata includes period, timezone and as_of. Staff with zero matching permitted records are absent; inactive agents with history may appear. Snapshot captured before streaming; export is a fresh read and can differ from a prior JSON page. UTF-8 BOM/RFC4180 CSV quotes multiline cells and prefixes formula/control-leading names to prevent spreadsheet formula execution. No source titles, customer contacts, emails, private notes or financial amounts.

Manual reference: fill IDs and timestamps in the environment first. Do not run this entire reference collection as a workflow. See OpenAPI/API.md for filters and alternatives.

List private property documents

Requires properties role permission, the document action permission and the corresponding documents:read/write token ability. All-permission roles still obey token abilities and current property own/group/global scope. Scope follows current property owner, not uploader. No public routes, storage paths or shared URLs. Fresh login required for new abilities. Requires properties.documents / documents:read. Newest ID first; no document metadata is embedded in general property resources.

Manual reference: fill IDs and timestamps in the environment first. Do not run this entire reference collection as a workflow. See OpenAPI/API.md for filters and alternatives.

Upload one private property document

Requires properties role permission, the document action permission and the corresponding documents:read/write token ability. All-permission roles still obey token abilities and current property own/group/global scope. Scope follows current property owner, not uploader. No public routes, storage paths or shared URLs. Fresh login required for new abilities. Requires properties.documents.create / documents:write. Single multipart file. Server controls property, uploader, MIME, bytes, checksum and UUID path. Repeated POST creates a separate document. Database rollback attempts new-file removal.

Manual reference: fill IDs and timestamps in the environment first. Do not run this entire reference collection as a workflow. See OpenAPI/API.md for filters and alternatives.

Download a private document attachment

Requires properties role permission, the document action permission and the corresponding documents:read/write token ability. All-permission roles still obey token abilities and current property own/group/global scope. Scope follows current property owner, not uploader. No public routes, storage paths or shared URLs. Fresh login required for new abilities. Requires properties.documents / documents:read. Document ID must belong to the URL property. Opens a private stream after authorization; already-open downloads may finish during deletion.

Manual reference: fill IDs and timestamps in the environment first. Do not run this entire reference collection as a workflow. See OpenAPI/API.md for filters and alternatives.

Delete a property document

Requires properties role permission, the document action permission and the corresponding documents:read/write token ability. All-permission roles still obey token abilities and current property own/group/global scope. Scope follows current property owner, not uploader. No public routes, storage paths or shared URLs. Fresh login required for new abilities. Requires properties.documents.delete / documents:write. Parent property deletion also removes documents under property-delete permission. Cleanup command is scheduled hourly; deployment must run Laravel scheduler. Database rollback preserves existing bytes.

Manual reference: fill IDs and timestamps in the environment first. Do not run this entire reference collection as a workflow. See OpenAPI/API.md for filters and alternatives.

List scoped property deal summaries

Requires deals / deals:read. Scope uses agent assigned at reservation. Lists omit customer identity/contacts, payment references, notes and events. from/to are inclusive ISO timestamps with seconds/timezone filtering created_at; to >= from. Newest ID first.

Manual reference: fill IDs and timestamps in the environment first. Do not run this entire reference collection as a workflow. See OpenAPI/API.md for filters and alternatives.

Reserve one property for a lead customer

Requires deals.create + deals.view / deals:write. Writes additionally require properties + properties.edit and properties:read + properties:write. Reserve/confirm also require leads.view + leads:read. Sources must be visible for actual changes; cancellation does not need lead access. All-permission roles still obey token and record scopes. Requires available inventory and an open lead with customer. Property/lead/customer/purpose/currency snapshots derived server-side; amount strings normalized exactly. Status becomes reserved and public catalogue/enquiries exclude the property. Parent locking/current reads and a unique active-property guard serialize bookings. Financial fields immutable; audit and inventory changes are atomic. No payment/refund processing. Existing matching request returns the same scoped deal without repeating mutations.

Manual reference: fill IDs and timestamps in the environment first. Do not run this entire reference collection as a workflow. See OpenAPI/API.md for filters and alternatives.

Show private deal detail and audit history

Requires deals.view / deals:read. Snapshot and financial history survive source deletion; nullable source IDs then return null. No public or hard-delete route.

Manual reference: fill IDs and timestamps in the environment first. Do not run this entire reference collection as a workflow. See OpenAPI/API.md for filters and alternatives.

Confirm property deal

Requires deals.confirm + deals.view / deals:write. Reserved becomes confirmed; property becomes sold (sale) or rented (rent). Revalidates current sources, hold, purpose/rental period and customer identity. Does not change CRM lead stage or transfer money. Writes additionally require properties + properties.edit and properties:read + properties:write. Reserve/confirm also require leads.view + leads:read. Sources must be visible for actual changes; cancellation does not need lead access. All-permission roles still obey token and record scopes. Repeating the same terminal action preserves timestamps, reasons and events. Confirmed/cancelled deals cannot reopen or change terminal state. Reserved property deletion is blocked; controlled status/purpose/rental period cannot be changed by ordinary property PUT.

Manual reference: fill IDs and timestamps in the environment first. Do not run this entire reference collection as a workflow. See OpenAPI/API.md for filters and alternatives.

Cancel property reservation

Requires deals.cancel + deals.view / deals:write. Reserved becomes cancelled and releases only its own hold to available, without overriding an externally changed status. Requires cancellation_reason. Recorded advance retained; no refund action. Closed/missing lead/customer does not prevent cancellation. Writes additionally require properties + properties.edit and properties:read + properties:write. Reserve/confirm also require leads.view + leads:read. Sources must be visible for actual changes; cancellation does not need lead access. All-permission roles still obey token and record scopes. Repeating the same terminal action preserves timestamps, reasons and events. Confirmed/cancelled deals cannot reopen or change terminal state. Reserved property deletion is blocked; controlled status/purpose/rental period cannot be changed by ordinary property PUT.

Manual reference: fill IDs and timestamps in the environment first. Do not run this entire reference collection as a workflow. See OpenAPI/API.md for filters and alternatives.

Requires stays / stays:read. See STAYS.md for date, snapshot, retry and cancellation rules.

Get minimum available rooms across a date range

Requires stays / stays:read. Advisory availability using peak nightly occupancy, exclusive checkout, local stay timezone, 1–365 nights. See STAYS.md for date, snapshot, retry and cancellation rules.

Manual reference: fill IDs and timestamps in the environment first. Do not run this entire reference collection as a workflow. See OpenAPI/API.md for filters and alternatives.

List scoped stay booking summaries

Requires stay-bookings / bookings:read. Lists omit guest/contact, request ID, notes, payment reference and events. See STAYS.md for date, snapshot, retry and cancellation rules. Booking finder filters combine stay_id, booking_id and inclusive arrival_from/arrival_to with room/status/attendance. Dates use each booking local scheduled check_in. List-only users retain existing private field omissions. Unmatched or contradictory IDs return an empty page; invalid filters return 422.

Manual reference: fill IDs and timestamps in the environment first. Do not run this entire reference collection as a workflow. See OpenAPI/API.md for filters and alternatives.

Create a confirmed stay booking

Requires stay-bookings.create + stay-bookings.view + stays / bookings:write + stays:read. UUID retries return the same record, including after cancellation. Flat nightly totals and offline advances are immutable records; no payment is collected. See STAYS.md for date, snapshot, retry and cancellation rules.

Manual reference: fill IDs and timestamps in the environment first. Do not run this entire reference collection as a workflow. See OpenAPI/API.md for filters and alternatives.

Read stay booking and history

Requires stay-bookings.view / bookings:read. See STAYS.md for date, snapshot, retry and cancellation rules.

Manual reference: fill IDs and timestamps in the environment first. Do not run this entire reference collection as a workflow. See OpenAPI/API.md for filters and alternatives.

Cancel a stay booking before local check-in date

Requires stay-bookings.cancel + stay-bookings.view / bookings:write. Repeated cancellation preserves original reason/history. No refund is initiated. See STAYS.md for date, snapshot, retry and cancellation rules.

Manual reference: fill IDs and timestamps in the environment first. Do not run this entire reference collection as a workflow. See OpenAPI/API.md for filters and alternatives.

Record guest check-in

Requires stay-bookings.check-in + stay-bookings.view / bookings:write. Only confirmed bookings. Record arrival within the booked check-in inclusive / checkout exclusive local-date window. Repeat requests preserve timestamp/history, including after departure. Timestamp and actor are server-generated. All mutations serialize on the source stay/room and booking locks.

Manual reference: fill IDs and timestamps in the environment first. Do not run this entire reference collection as a workflow. See OpenAPI/API.md for filters and alternatives.

Record guest check-out

Requires stay-bookings.check-out + stay-bookings.view / bookings:write. Only confirmed bookings. Record departure only after arrival. Early departure does not release scheduled inventory, reprice charges, alter advances or initiate refunds. Repeat requests preserve timestamp/history. Timestamp and actor are server-generated. All mutations serialize on the source stay/room and booking locks.

Manual reference: fill IDs and timestamps in the environment first. Do not run this entire reference collection as a workflow. See OpenAPI/API.md for filters and alternatives.

List private offline ledger and exact financial totals

Requires stay-bookings.view + stay-bookings.payments and bookings:read. Uses booking visibility, immutable entries, exact cents and current locking reads. No money is transferred or verified. See PAYMENTS.md for correction order, cancellation, refund and retry rules.

Manual reference: fill IDs and timestamps in the environment first. Do not run this entire reference collection as a workflow. See OpenAPI/API.md for filters and alternatives.

Record additional offline payment

Requires stay-bookings.view + stay-bookings.payments and bookings:read + stay-bookings.payments.create + bookings:write. Uses booking visibility, immutable entries, exact cents and current locking reads. No money is transferred or verified. See PAYMENTS.md for correction order, cancellation, refund and retry rules.

Manual reference: fill IDs and timestamps in the environment first. Do not run this entire reference collection as a workflow. See OpenAPI/API.md for filters and alternatives.

Record offline refund with a reason

Requires stay-bookings.view + stay-bookings.payments and bookings:read + stay-bookings.payments.refund + bookings:write. Uses booking visibility, immutable entries, exact cents and current locking reads. No money is transferred or verified. See PAYMENTS.md for correction order, cancellation, refund and retry rules.

Manual reference: fill IDs and timestamps in the environment first. Do not run this entire reference collection as a workflow. See OpenAPI/API.md for filters and alternatives.

Append reversal of an incorrect original entry

Requires stay-bookings.view + stay-bookings.payments and bookings:read + stay-bookings.payments.reverse + bookings:write. Uses booking visibility, immutable entries, exact cents and current locking reads. No money is transferred or verified. See PAYMENTS.md for correction order, cancellation, refund and retry rules.

Manual reference: fill IDs and timestamps in the environment first. Do not run this entire reference collection as a workflow. See OpenAPI/API.md for filters and alternatives.

Read nightly room-type availability calendar

Requires stays / stays:read and scoped stay visibility. Read-only nightly room allocations with current capacity, no guest/contact/payment data. Dates use the stay timezone; from is inclusive and to exclusive, 1–62 nights. Historical rows use current inventory and may flag over-capacity. Early checkout retains original allocation. Inactive inventory has zero bookable availability. No-store; counts are advisory and booking save rechecks inventory.

Manual reference: fill IDs and timestamps in the environment first. Do not run this entire reference collection as a workflow. See OpenAPI/API.md for filters and alternatives.

Read staff stay operations queues

Requires stays + stay-bookings + stay-bookings.view and stays:read + bookings:read, with both stay and booking visibility. Scheduled arrivals/departures use selected date (defaults to stay local today). in_house and overdue are live attendance snapshots, independent of selected date; overdue means check_out before local today and no recorded departure. Cancelled bookings excluded. Counts are booking counts, not room counts. Curated rows include guest name but no contacts, notes or financial metadata. Read-only; actions remain on booking detail. Consistent snapshot with no-store.

Manual reference: fill IDs and timestamps in the environment first. Do not run this entire reference collection as a workflow. See OpenAPI/API.md for filters and alternatives.

Current outstanding collection and refund queues

Requires stays, stay-bookings, stay-bookings.view and stay-bookings.payments ACL plus stays:read and bookings:read. Independent stay/booking visibility applies. Effective immutable ledger excludes reversed entries. Cancelled bookings have zero amount due. Current balances, no date filter or automatic money movement. Oldest check-in then booking ID order. Counts are bookings, not monetary totals. Inactive stays remain visible. No contacts, references, notes or hashes. Cache-Control: no-store.

Manual reference: fill IDs and timestamps in the environment first. Do not run this entire reference collection as a workflow. See OpenAPI/API.md for filters and alternatives.

Read a complete printable booking account statement

Requires stay-bookings.view + stay-bookings.payments ACL and bookings:read, with existing booking visibility. Read-only locked snapshot of booking and all ledger entries in ascending ID order, without pagination or truncation. Curated guest name and exact financial summary; excludes contacts, internal notes, bank references, reasons, staff IDs, request IDs and hashes. Reversed entries/corrections remain visible but excluded from effective totals. Cancelled bookings owe zero and retain any refund due. Offline account statement, not a tax invoice or transfer of money. Cache-Control: no-store.

Manual reference: fill IDs and timestamps in the environment first. Do not run this entire reference collection as a workflow. See OpenAPI/API.md for filters and alternatives.

List active published stays

Anonymous. Exact city filter, ascending stay ID, only active published stays with at least one active published room. Starting rate/count consider only visible rooms. Omits inventory quantity, owners, booking/guest/payment metadata. No online booking or date availability.

Manual reference: fill IDs and timestamps in the environment first. Do not run this entire reference collection as a workflow. See OpenAPI/API.md for filters and alternatives.

Read public stay and visible room details

Anonymous curated marketing content. Parent and rooms must both be active/published; no eligible rooms returns 404. No staff scope or fallback.

Manual reference: fill IDs and timestamps in the environment first. Do not run this entire reference collection as a workflow. See OpenAPI/API.md for filters and alternatives.

Read scoped stay content for editing

Requires stays ACL and stays:read. Includes existing stay inventory/room records and unpublished content; no booking data.

Manual reference: fill IDs and timestamps in the environment first. Do not run this entire reference collection as a workflow. See OpenAPI/API.md for filters and alternatives.

Save stay marketing content

Requires stays + stays.manage and stays:write. Source lock, own/group/global scope, maximum 10 gallery photos. Uploads cleaned on DB rollback; removed files deleted after commit on a best-effort basis. Public marketing files, not private documents.

Manual reference: fill IDs and timestamps in the environment first. Do not run this entire reference collection as a workflow. See OpenAPI/API.md for filters and alternatives.

Save room marketing content

Same content rules/permissions. Room must belong to the authorized stay. Parent then room lock order; inventory/rates/booking snapshots unchanged.

Manual reference: fill IDs and timestamps in the environment first. Do not run this entire reference collection as a workflow. See OpenAPI/API.md for filters and alternatives.
